tax.text: He offered an amendment to support Medicare solvency by closing tax loopholes and requiring higher contributions from wealthy taxpayers.
tax.quote: His first amendment would support protecting and extending Medicare’s solvency by closing tax loopholes and requiring wealthy taxpayers to contribute more to Medicare.

wages.text: He cosponsored the Raise the Wage Act of 2025, which would increase the federal minimum wage.
wages.quote: To provide for increases in the Federal minimum wage, and for other purposes.

trade.text: Amo opposed Trump’s tariffs, saying they made it harder for Rhode Island businesses to plan, hire, and succeed.
trade.quote: Trump’s on-again, off-again tariffs are making it difficult for Rhode Island businesses to plan, hire, and succeed

debt.text: His campaign said he fought to protect Social Security and Medicare.
debt.quote: Gabe fought to protect Social Security and Medicare and worked with local leaders to rebuild communities shattered by gun violence.

immigration.text: He voted against legislation to add funding for ICE and deportation enforcement, calling it an expansion of the deportation system.
immigration.quote: Now they’ve doubled down, giving another $70 billion of your money to expand Trump’s ICE force and bankroll more abuses of power.

abortion.text: Amo’s campaign said he would protect women’s reproductive freedom and oppose attacks on abortion rights.
abortion.quote: In Congress, Gabe will always stand up to extreme MAGA Republicans to be a voice for Rhode Island’s Democratic values and protect women’s reproductive freedom.

health.text: Amo joined a call for Congress to defend Medicaid against efforts to take health insurance away from millions of Americans.
health.quote: defend Medicaid against ongoing Republican efforts to take health insurance away from millions of Americans

energy.text: He introduced an amendment to reverse energy cuts and has opposed the cancellation of clean-energy projects.
energy.quote: Amo introduced an Amendment to reverse the energy cuts in the Big, Ugly Law and lower costs for consumers.

tax.text: Her platform calls for tax relief for working families and seniors.
tax.quote: Provide tax relief for working families and seniors

schools.text: Her platform supports school choice and homeschooling options.
schools.quote: Support standardized testing & focusing on real academic outcomes Strengthen civics and financial literacy Support school choice and homeschooling options Ensure transparency for parents and communities

energy.text: Her platform calls for lower energy costs and a diversified energy mix.
energy.quote: Lower energy costs for Rhode Island families Increase transparency and accountability for ratepayers Diversify our energy mix for long-term stability Explore next-generation nuclear as part of a balanced energy future
